title: Assign existing technical identities without duplicating inventory or personas
preconditions: Have existing proposed System S, Component C and data entity E with relevant design links, plus an unrelated Component U and a work item W. A supported public entity-scope assignment operation must exist.

steps.action: Assign S, C and E identities and their existing design context to W through the public work-planning API.
steps.expected_result: Assignment stores references to those exact existing identities.

steps.action: Query W, inventory and personas and compare to the pre-assignment inventories.
steps.expected_result: No duplicate technical definitions or AI-worker persona are created; assignment shows S/C/E and design references.

expected_result: Work scope references shared technical entities without duplicating their definitions.
